hypothesis: Placing FACT clean-action and consequence tracks inside all thirty H3-conditioned action-generation blocks will convert H3 future prediction supervision into action-policy gradients without future-to-action leakage.
single_variable: Relative to the C58b layer-wise H3-to-FastWAM tower, add FACT A/G/future-state/value/future-H3 token tracks, per-token clean/noisy timestep modulation, the official teacher-forcing visibility mask, and the official 10:1:0.4:0.4 losses inside the same thirty blocks.
parent_baseline: C58b initialized exactly from D0-H32-s14000 SHA256 36c5615746fcd57f834db4cdbedd7a124174fca634786e1353871ded6b6e6de3; C56b Stage1 delegates byte-exactly to C58b.

references.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
C56b shared FACT layer-wise H3 tower
references.revision: C58b dependency commit 90324d6 plus C56b working diff

architecture.paper: P/A/G/V/I traverse one causal video transformer at every layer
architecture.upstream_code: WanTransformerBlock applies one masked self-attention to the complete teacher-forcing sequence
architecture.local: Each of the thirty C58b ActionDiT blocks receives its mapped H3 K/V prefix P and jointly updates A/G/future-state/value/I with one FACT mask; no independent TransformerEncoder exists
architecture.rationale: The shared-block property is preserved, but H3 P is a frozen layer-wise K/V prefix rather than trainable Wan RGB tokens. This is the declared H3 backbone substitution, not an appended auxiliary trunk.

architecture.paper: [P|A|G|future-state|value|I], A cannot read G/V/I and G cannot read A
architecture.upstream_code: _build_teacher_forcing_mask supplies the same segment relation matrix
architecture.local: C56b slices the byte-audited C56a full FACT mask to P-prefix K/V plus A/G/V/I query tracks
architecture.rationale: The visibility relation is tensor-identical; only P storage is external layer-wise H3 K/V.

data.field: expert, observational failure and causal failure streams
data.paper: demonstrations plus failure rollouts with explicit failure onset
data.upstream_code: success/failure episodes share one loader; failed actions are masked while future/value train
data.local: Expert dense LIBERO demos, C59 observational failures, and C60 83 exact-state counterfactual branches are separate immutable streams; C60 dataset SHA256 1abeee1ef4e5e71f66b656c9920124086046c3e7d3b3a22b769449b72b1fc1d4
data.rationale: LIBERO replaces RoboTwin. Five-layer C60 assets are explicitly ineligible; formal C56b training requires READY_LAYERWISE30.json with exact 30-layer K/V and audited future-H3 coverage.

action.field: action horizon, encoder sharing and failure mask
action.paper: A and G share one action encoder; failed episode actions are not imitated
action.upstream_code: action_encoder is shared by pred_action/gt_action and action_loss_mask zeros failure imitation
action.local: C56b A/G share the C58b ActionDiT action_encoder, retains horizon32 D0 normalization/padding, and reuses C59/C60 whole-failure action masks
action.rationale: LIBERO absolute 7D horizon32 replaces RoboTwin delta 14D horizon48; the deployed action contract stays fixed for attribution.

objective.field: joint flow objectives and shared gradient path
objective.paper: action/future-image/future-state/value flow losses weighted 10:1:0.4:0.4 update one backbone
objective.upstream_code: clean G conditions consequences while A is causally isolated
objective.local: Future-H3 tokens replace future RGB latents with exact relative weights; future-only backward reaches all thirty action-generation blocks and the shared A/G encoder
objective.rationale: The predicted modality changes from RGB latent to H3 world representation, while the causal condition and shared-block optimization mechanism remain the same.

optimization.paper: 8 GPUs, large batches and long training
optimization.upstream_code: 150000 steps with separate base/action learning rates
optimization.local: Eight A800 ranks each consume one real layer-wise H3 demo cache item and run one AdamW step at 2e-5; initialization and optimizer-step timings are reported separately
optimization.rationale: This is a bounded architecture/restore/memory canary only, not an effectiveness budget.

evaluation.local: Fixed offline checks are diagnostic; promotion requires fresh episode-disjoint LIBERO closed-loop success against D0/C58b and a matched action-only continuation
evaluation.rationale: LIBERO is the project benchmark and success rate remains the decisive metric.

evidence: FACT commit 618a6c1 and C58b dependency commit 90324d6 are fixed; FastWAM source bytes are pinned.

C56b contains no nn.TransformerEncoder; five focused tests prove all thirty shared blocks execute and Stage1 remains exact C58b. The same five tests passed on n0 in 6.17 s using pinned FastWAM source /mnt/h3-wam/upstream-readonly/FastWAM-45d8e145/wan22 on 2026-08-16.

C60 dataset/observations SHA256 are fixed; the layerwise launcher refuses training use without exact 30-layer count/hash/missing/extra/partial READY audit. A/G share the same C58b action encoder; failure action masking and future/value retention are directly tested.
The audited 10:1:0.4:0.4 loss helper is reused; future-only loss updates the same thirty action blocks.
Mechanical launcher fixes 8 ranks, explicit parent SHA, one step by default and a fresh output root.
Probe reports NOT_EVIDENCE_READY; no mechanical result can promote a model.
Local test observes nonzero future-only gradients in all thirty shared self-attention output projections and the shared A/G encoder.

Local small-dimension full30 forward/backward is finite; 20 combined C56a/C56b/C58b tests pass. Remote n0 repeats all five focused C56b tests successfully in 6.17 s with the pinned FastWAM source mirror.
Local strict state restore reproduces A/future-state/value/I bit exactly; real launcher repeats full-state in-memory restore.
C56b forward_action is byte-exact C58b in the local test; D0 parent SHA is launcher-verified.
No real C56b mechanical result or trained checkpoint exists yet.
No C56b checkpoint has run fresh LIBERO episodes.

decision.rationale: Source, shared-block architecture, mask, gradient, failure-mask and restore contracts permit exactly one real 8-rank mechanical step after the C58b 80-item layer-wise cache is READY. Long training remains blocked on C60 READY_LAYERWISE30.json and a real finite canary.
